items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Roosevelt, who became the modern Commander In Chief, and it began to lighten you see because he sensibly started that whatever he called it—The New Deal. And that helped the guys.

ctx.x: Roosevelt, who became the modern Commander In Chief, and it began to lighten you see because he sensibly started that whatever he called it—The New Deal. And that helped the guys. That helped bolster the guys too. And it introduced a breath of fresh air. And so Chicago was down, although the south side was always romping, always. Later Stanley and I, I think we took Earl there, I know I went with somebody, and it was still the Club DeLisa, and I mean it was still wild. In the early days of course it was Louis —…
